key.name: start-at-login
key.description: Whether Ari starts when you log in. Ari keeps running in the background either way.

key.name: language
key.description: The language Ari understands and answers in, as a language code. Empty follows the system's language where Ari has it, else English.

key.name: conversation-memory
key.description: Whether Ari keeps the last few things said, so follow-up questions are answered in context.

key.name: conversation-length
key.description: Short is five exchanges, forgotten after 90 seconds of quiet; medium ten after 5 minutes; long twenty after 15 minutes.

key.name: assistant
key.description: The id of the assistant that answers when no skill does. Empty for none.
